name: SQL Formatter
summary: Pretty-print SQL with uppercase keywords, indented JOINs, and advanced layout options — in your browser.
description: Format SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE style SQL with major clauses on their own lines. Choose keyword case, indent size or tabs, toggle JOIN/AND-OR breaks, and split SELECT lists. Minify when you need a one-liner. String literals are preserved. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: Which SQL dialects are supported?
faqs.answer: It targets common ANSI-style SQL. Exotic vendor syntax may still format, but is best-effort.

faqs.question: What advanced options are available?
faqs.answer: Keyword case (upper/lower/preserve), 2/4-space or tab indent, JOIN indentation, AND/OR line breaks, and SELECT list splitting.

faqs.question: Does it validate my query?
faqs.answer: No. It only reformats whitespace and keyword casing.

faqs.question: Is my SQL uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
